2. **`src/lib.rs:8` — Out-of-bounds SIMD reads** — `_mm_loadu_ps` reads 16 bytes per iteration with no `i + 4 <= input.len()` check. Non-multiple-of-4 inputs read past slice boundary → UB.

4. **`src/lib.rs:1` — No tests** — Zero test module in the entire crate. Edge cases (empty, remainder) go unverified.
5. **`src/lib.rs:3` — No Miri** — Unsafe code without UB analysis.
6. **`src/lib.rs:1` — No benchmark** — SIMD claim without workload, baseline, or measured improvement.
7. **`src/lib.rs:1` — No `target_feature` gate** — SSE intrinsics without `#[target_feature(enable = "sse")]` or runtime detection → SIGILL on SSE-less x86_64.
